passages.text: For toner cartridges, the supplier may invoice at most INR 100 for each cartridge. Any unit price above this contractual ceiling requires review.
An office supply invoice may exceed the listed maximum price by no more than five percent. A larger overage is outside the agreed tolerance.
The agreed price schedule applies from 1 January through 31 December 2025. Purchases dated outside this period require a different active agreement.
The vendor must deliver replacement laptops within ten calendar days of receiving a purchase order. Late deliveries are escalated to procurement review.
Each invoice number must be unique for a supplier. Finance must hold a second bill with the same supplier, amount and invoice number until the duplicate is resolved.
Multiple purchase orders for the same requirement on one day may not be split to stay below the manager approval threshold. Aggregate their value for authorization.
A supplier must hold current liability insurance before starting on-site maintenance. An expired insurance certificate blocks the work order.
A change to a vendor bank account requires independent verification by a second employee using a previously recorded contact channel before payment details are updated.
The supplier tax registration identifier on the invoice must match the approved vendor master record. A mismatched tax ID is sent to compliance for review.
Before paying a hardware invoice, accounts payable must match the invoice, purchase order and goods receipt for product and quantity. Unreceived goods cannot be paid.
If an invoice uses a currency different from the purchase order, convert using the official rate recorded on the invoice date and preserve the rate source.
For a partial shipment, pay only for accepted units already delivered. The undelivered balance remains open on the purchase order.
The printer warranty covers manufacturing defects for twelve months after acceptance. The vendor must repair or replace a defective unit at no additional charge.
Damaged furniture may be returned within thirty days of receipt. A credit note must reference the original invoice and the returned quantity.
Payment is due thirty days after receipt of a valid invoice and accepted delivery. Early payment requires a separately approved discount.
The contractor may not subcontract security monitoring without written approval. Approved subcontractors remain subject to the same confidentiality duties.
